translations.literal: The next day the Three Elder sent a chief memorial to the palace thanking the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the Three Elder sent a chief memorial thanking the emperor.

sentences.zh: 州貢明經、秀才、進士身孝悌旌表門閭者，行鄉飲酒之禮，皆刺史為主人。

translations.literal: Those presented by the provinces as classics masters, cultivated talents, or advanced scholars for filial piety and fraternal duty with commendation at the gate performed the village drinking rite, with the prefect as host.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial nominees in classics, cultivated talent, or advanced scholar categories who were commended for filial piety held the village drinking rite with the prefect as host.

sentences.zh: 先召鄉致仕有德者謀之，賢者為賓，其次為介，又其次為眾賓，與之行禮，而賓舉之。

translations.literal: Retired village worthies of virtue were first summoned to deliberate; the worthy became Guest, the next Assistant, then again Mass Guest; the rite was performed with them and the Guest made nominations.
translations.idiomatic: Virtuous retired villagers were consulted first; the worthiest became Guest, the next Assistant, then Mass Guests; the rite was performed and the Guest made nominations.

sentences.zh: 主人戒賓，立於大門外之西，東面；

translations.literal: The host admonished the Guest, standing west of the great gate outside, facing east;
translations.idiomatic: The host invited the Guest, standing west outside the main gate, facing east;

sentences.zh: 賓立於東階下，西面。

translations.literal: the Guest stood below the eastern steps, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: the Guest stood below the east steps, facing west.

sentences.zh: 將命者立于賓之左，北面，受命出，立於門外之東，西面，曰：「敢請事。

translations.literal: The messenger stood left of the Guest, facing north, received the command and went out, stood east outside the gate, faced west, and said: "I venture to request your service.
translations.idiomatic: The messenger stood left of the Guest, faced north, took the message, went out east of the gate, faced west, and said: "I venture to request your attendance.

sentences.zh: 」主人曰：「某日行鄉飲酒之禮，請吾子臨之。

translations.literal: " The host said: "On such-and-such a day we perform the village drinking rite—may my lord attend.
translations.idiomatic: " The host said: "On such-and-such a day we hold the village drinking rite—please attend.

sentences.zh: 」將命者入告，賓出，立於門東，西面拜辱，主人答拜。

translations.literal: " The messenger entered to report; the Guest came out, stood east of the gate, faced west, and bowed for the honor; the host returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: " The messenger reported inside; the Guest came out east of the gate, faced west, bowed for the honor; the host returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 主人曰：「吾子學優行高，應茲觀國，某日展禮，請吾子臨之。

translations.literal: The host said: "My lord's learning is excellent and conduct lofty—you should now observe the capital; on such-and-such a day we display the rite—may my lord attend.
translations.idiomatic: The host said: "Your learning excels and conduct is lofty—you should now visit the capital; on such-and-such a day we perform the rite—please attend.

sentences.zh: 」賓曰：「某固陋，恐辱命，敢辭。

translations.literal: " The Guest said: "I am indeed crude and fear disgracing the commission—I venture to decline.
translations.idiomatic: " The Guest said: "I am unworthy and fear disgracing the task—I must decline.

sentences.zh: 」主人曰：「某謀于父師，莫若吾子賢，敢固以請。

translations.literal: " The host said: "I consulted the village fathers and elders—none equals my lord in worth—I venture firmly to request.
translations.idiomatic: " The host said: "I consulted village elders—none matches your worth—I insist on asking.

sentences.zh: 」賓曰：「夫子申命之，某敢不敬須。

translations.literal: " The Guest said: "The master has repeated the command—I dare not but respectfully await.
translations.idiomatic: " The Guest said: "You have pressed the command—I dare not but respectfully wait.

sentences.zh: 」主人再拜，賓答拜，主人退，賓拜送。

translations.literal: " The host bowed twice; the Guest returned the bow; the host withdrew; the Guest bowed in farewell.
translations.idiomatic: " The host bowed twice; the Guest returned it; the host withdrew; the Guest bowed him off.

sentences.zh: 其戒介亦如之，辭曰；

translations.literal: Admonishing the Assistant was likewise, with the wording:
translations.idiomatic: Inviting the Assistant followed the same form, with the words:

sentences.zh: 「某日行鄉飲酒之禮，請吾子貳之。」

translations.literal: "On such-and-such a day we perform the village drinking rite—may my lord assist."
translations.idiomatic: "On such-and-such a day we hold the village drinking rite—please assist."

sentences.zh: 其日質明，設賓席於楹間，近北，南向；

translations.literal: On that day at dawn, the Guest's mat was set between pillars, near the north, facing south;
translations.idiomatic: At dawn that day, the Guest's mat was set between pillars near the north, facing south;

sentences.zh: 主人席于阼階上，西向；

translations.literal: the host's mat on the host steps, facing west;
translations.idiomatic: the host's mat on the host steps, facing west;

sentences.zh: 介席於西階上，東向；

translations.literal: the Assistant's mat on the western steps, facing east;
translations.idiomatic: the Assistant's mat on the west steps, facing east;

sentences.zh: 眾賓席三于賓席之西，南向；

translations.literal: three Mass Guest mats west of the Guest's mat, facing south;
translations.idiomatic: three Mass Guest mats west of the Guest, facing south;

sentences.zh: 皆不屬。

translations.literal: all not connected.
translations.idiomatic: none adjoining.

sentences.zh: 又設堂下眾賓席於西階西南，東面北上。

translations.literal: Mass Guest mats below the hall were also set southwest of the western steps, facing east and ascending north.
translations.idiomatic: Courtyard Mass Guest mats were set southwest of the west steps, facing east with precedence north.

sentences.zh: 設兩壺于賓席之東，少北，玄酒在西，加勺冪。

translations.literal: Two wine jars were set east of the Guest's mat, slightly north; dark liquor on the west, with ladles and covers added.
translations.idiomatic: Two wine jars stood east of the Guest's mat, slightly north; dark liquor west, with ladles and covers.

sentences.zh: 置篚于壺南，東肆，實以爵觶。

translations.literal: A basket was set south of the jars, laid eastward, filled with goblets and cups.
translations.idiomatic: A basket south of the jars, laid east, held goblets and cups.

sentences.zh: 設贊者位於東階東，西向北上。

translations.literal: Announcers' positions were set east of the eastern steps, facing west and ascending north.
translations.idiomatic: Announcers stood east of the east steps, facing west with precedence north.

sentences.zh: 賓、介及眾賓至，位於大門外之右，東面北上。

translations.literal: When Guest, Assistant, and Mass Guests arrived, they stood right outside the great gate, facing east and ascending north.
translations.idiomatic: When Guest, Assistant, and Mass Guests arrived, they stood right outside the main gate, facing east with precedence north.

sentences.zh: 主人迎賓于門外之左，西面拜賓，賓答拜；

translations.literal: The host welcomed the Guest left outside the gate, faced west and bowed to the Guest; the Guest returned the bow;
translations.idiomatic: The host welcomed the Guest left of the gate, faced west and bowed; the Guest returned the bow;

sentences.zh: 又西南面拜介，介答拜；

translations.literal: again bowed southwest to the Assistant; the Assistant returned the bow;
translations.idiomatic: then bowed southwest to the Assistant, who returned it;

sentences.zh: 又西南面揖眾賓，眾賓報揖。

translations.literal: again bowed southwest and saluted the Mass Guests; Mass Guests returned the salute.
translations.idiomatic: then saluted southwest to Mass Guests, who returned the salute.

sentences.zh: 主人又揖賓，賓報揖。

translations.literal: The host again saluted the Guest; the Guest returned the salute.
translations.idiomatic: The host saluted the Guest again; the Guest returned it.

sentences.zh: 主人先入門而右，西面。

translations.literal: The host entered the gate first to the right, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The host entered first to the right, facing west.

sentences.zh: 賓入門而左，東面。

translations.literal: The Guest entered the gate to the left, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The Guest entered left, facing east.

sentences.zh: 介及眾賓序入，立於賓西南，東面北上。

translations.literal: Assistant and Mass Guests entered in order and stood southwest of the Guest, facing east and ascending north.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant and Mass Guests entered in order southwest of the Guest, facing east with precedence north.

sentences.zh: 眾賓非三賓者皆北面東上。

translations.literal: Mass Guests who were not among the three Guests all faced north and ascended east.
translations.idiomatic: Mass Guests not among the three Guests faced north with precedence east.

sentences.zh: 主人將進揖，當階揖，賓皆報揖。

translations.literal: As the host was about to advance with salutes, he saluted at the step; Guests all returned the salute.
translations.idiomatic: As the host advanced with salutes, he saluted at the step; all Guests returned them.

sentences.zh: 及階，主人曰：「請吾子升。

translations.literal: At the steps the host said: "Please ascend, my lord.
translations.idiomatic: At the steps the host said: "Please ascend.

sentences.zh: 」賓曰：「某敢辭。

translations.literal: " The Guest said: "I venture to decline.
translations.idiomatic: " The Guest said: "I must decline.

sentences.zh: 」主人曰：「固請吾子升。

translations.literal: " The host said: "I firmly request that my lord ascend.
translations.idiomatic: " The host said: "I insist—please ascend.

sentences.zh: 」賓曰：「某敢固辭。

translations.literal: " The Guest said: "I venture firmly to decline.
translations.idiomatic: " The Guest said: "I must firmly decline.

sentences.zh: 」主人曰：「終請吾子升。

translations.literal: " The host said: "I finally request that my lord ascend.
translations.idiomatic: " The host said: "I ask once more—please ascend.

sentences.zh: 」賓曰：「某敢終辭。

translations.literal: " The Guest said: "I venture finally to decline.
translations.idiomatic: " The Guest said: "I must finally decline.

sentences.zh: 」主人升自阼階，賓升自西階，當楣，北面立。

translations.literal: " The host ascended by the host steps; the Guest ascended by the western steps and stood north of the lintel, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: " The host ascended the host steps; the Guest the west steps and stood north of the lintel, facing north.

sentences.zh: 執尊者徹冪。

translations.literal: Those holding the honored vessels removed the covers.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants removed the vessel covers.

sentences.zh: 主人適篚，跪取爵，興，適尊實之，進賓席前，西北面獻賓。

translations.literal: The host went to the basket, knelt, took a goblet, rose, went to the vessel and filled it, advanced before the Guest's mat, and presented northwest to the Guest.
translations.idiomatic: The host went to the basket, knelt, took a goblet, filled it at the vessel, advanced before the Guest's mat, and presented northwest to the Guest.

sentences.zh: 賓西階上北面拜。

translations.literal: The Guest on the western steps bowed northward.
translations.idiomatic: The Guest on the west steps bowed facing north.

sentences.zh: 主人少退，賓進于席前，受爵，退，復西階上，北面立。

translations.literal: The host withdrew slightly; the Guest advanced before the mat, received the goblet, withdrew, and again stood on the western steps facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The host stepped back; the Guest advanced, received the goblet, withdrew, and stood again on the west steps facing north.

sentences.zh: 主人退于阼階上，北面拜，送爵。

translations.literal: The host withdrew to the host steps, bowed northward, and sent off the goblet.
translations.idiomatic: The host withdrew to the host steps, bowed north, and sent off the goblet.

sentences.zh: 賓少退，贊者薦脯、醢于賓席前。

translations.literal: The Guest withdrew slightly; announcers presented dried meat and relish before the Guest's mat.
translations.idiomatic: The Guest stepped back; announcers set dried meat and relish before his mat.

sentences.zh: 賓自西方升席，南面立。

translations.literal: The Guest ascended the mat from the west, stood southward on the mat.
translations.idiomatic: The Guest ascended from the west and stood on the mat facing south.

sentences.zh: 贊者設折俎，賓跪，左執爵，右取脯，擩於醢，祭於籩、豆之間，遂祭酒，啐酒，興，降席東，適西階上，北面跪，卒爵，執爵興，適尊實之，進主人席前，東面酢主人。

translations.literal: Announcers set the divided offering; the Guest knelt, held the goblet in his left hand, took dried meat in his right, dipped it in relish, offered between the baskets and beans, then offered the wine, tasted the wine, rose, descended east of the mat, went to the western steps, knelt northward, finished the goblet, held the goblet and rose, went to the vessel and filled it, advanced before the host's mat, faced east, and toasted the host.
translations.idiomatic: Announcers set the divided meat; the Guest knelt, goblet left, took meat right, dipped relish, offered between baskets and beans, offered and tasted wine, rose, went east of the mat to the west steps, knelt north, drained the goblet, refilled it, advanced before the host's mat facing east, and toasted the host.

sentences.zh: 主人于阼階上北面拜，賓少退。

translations.literal: The host on the host steps bowed northward; the Guest withdrew slightly.
translations.idiomatic: The host on the host steps bowed north; the Guest stepped back.

sentences.zh: 主人進受爵，退阼階上，北面立。

translations.literal: The host advanced and received the goblet, withdrew to the host steps, and stood facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The host advanced, received the goblet, withdrew to the host steps, and stood facing north.

sentences.zh: 賓退，復西階上，北面拜，送爵。

translations.literal: The Guest withdrew and again stood on the western steps, bowed northward, and sent off the goblet.
translations.idiomatic: The Guest withdrew to the west steps, bowed north, and sent off the goblet.

sentences.zh: 贊者薦脯、醢于主人席前，主人由席東自北方升席，贊者設折俎，主人跪，左執爵，右祭脯，擩於醢，祭於籩、豆之間，遂祭酒，啐酒，興，自南方降席，復阼階上，北面跪，卒爵，執爵興，跪奠爵於東序端，興，適篚，跪取觶實之以酬，復阼階上，北面跪，奠觶，遂拜，執觶興。

translations.literal: Announcers presented dried meat and relish before the host's mat; the host ascended the mat from the east by the north, announcers set the divided offering; the host knelt, held the goblet left, offered dried meat right, dipped in relish, offered between baskets and beans, offered and tasted wine, rose, descended south of the mat, again stood on the host steps, knelt northward, finished the goblet, held the goblet and rose, knelt and set the goblet at the east end of the sequence, rose, went to the basket, knelt and took a cup to fill for the return toast, again stood on the host steps, knelt northward, set the cup, then bowed and held the cup and rose.
translations.idiomatic: Announcers set relish before the host; he ascended from the east, announcers set divided meat; he knelt, goblet left, offered meat, dipped relish, offered between baskets and beans, offered and tasted wine, rose, descended south, returned to the host steps, knelt north, drained the goblet, set it at the east end, took a cup from the basket for the return toast, knelt north, set the cup, bowed, and rose with cup.

sentences.zh: 賓西階上答拜。

translations.literal: The Guest on the western steps returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The Guest on the west steps returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 主人跪酒祭，遂飲，卒觶，執觶興，適尊實之，進賓席前，北面。

translations.literal: The host knelt, offered wine in libation, then drank, finished the cup, held the cup and rose, went to the vessel and filled it, advanced before the Guest's mat, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The host knelt, libated, drank, finished the cup, refilled it, and advanced before the Guest's mat facing north.

sentences.zh: 賓拜，主人少退。

translations.literal: The Guest bowed; the host withdrew slightly.
translations.idiomatic: The Guest bowed; the host stepped back.

sentences.zh: 賓既拜，主人跪奠觶於薦西，興，復阼階上位。

translations.literal: After the Guest had bowed, the host knelt and set the cup west of the offering, rose, and again took position on the host steps.
translations.idiomatic: After the Guest bowed, the host knelt, set the cup west of the offering, rose, and returned to the host steps.

sentences.zh: 賓遂進席前，北面跪，取觶，興，復西階上位。

translations.literal: The Guest then advanced before the mat, knelt northward, took the cup, rose, and again stood on the western steps.
translations.idiomatic: The Guest advanced to the mat, knelt north, took the cup, rose, and stood on the west steps.

sentences.zh: 主人北面拜送。

translations.literal: The host bowed northward and sent it off.
translations.idiomatic: The host bowed north and sent it off.

sentences.zh: 賓進席前，北面跪，奠觶於薦東，興，復西階上位。

translations.literal: The Guest advanced before the mat, knelt northward, set the cup east of the offering, rose, and again stood on the western steps.
translations.idiomatic: The Guest advanced, knelt north, set the cup east of the offering, rose, and stood on the west steps.

sentences.zh: 主人北面揖，降，立阼階下，西面。

translations.literal: The host bowed northward and saluted, descended, and stood below the host steps facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The host bowed north, saluted, descended, and stood below the host steps facing west.

sentences.zh: 賓降，立於階西，東面。

translations.literal: The Guest descended and stood west of the steps facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The Guest descended and stood west of the steps facing east.

sentences.zh: 主人進延介，揖之，介報揖。

translations.literal: The host advanced to extend welcome to the Assistant and saluted him; the Assistant returned the salute.
translations.idiomatic: The host advanced to welcome the Assistant and saluted; the Assistant returned it.

sentences.zh: 至介，一讓升，主人升阼階，介升西階，當楣，北面立。

translations.literal: Reaching the Assistant, one yielding ascent; the host ascended the host steps, the Assistant ascended the western steps, stood north of the lintel, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: At the Assistant, one round of yielding; the host ascended the host steps, the Assistant the west steps, and stood north of the lintel facing north.

sentences.zh: 主人詣東序端，跪取爵，興，適尊實之。

translations.literal: The host went to the east end of the sequence, knelt, took a goblet, rose, and went to the vessel to fill it.
translations.idiomatic: The host went to the east end, knelt, took a goblet, rose, and filled it at the vessel.

sentences.zh: 進于介席前，西南面獻介。

translations.literal: He advanced before the Assistant's mat and presented southwest to the Assistant.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced before the Assistant's mat and presented southwest to the Assistant.

sentences.zh: 介西階上北面拜，主人少退，介進，北面受爵，退，復位。

translations.literal: The Assistant on the western steps bowed northward; the host withdrew slightly; the Assistant advanced, received the goblet northward, withdrew, and returned to position.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant on the west steps bowed north; the host stepped back; the Assistant advanced, received the goblet facing north, withdrew, and returned to station.

sentences.zh: 主人于介右北面拜送爵，介少退，主人立于西階之東。

translations.literal: The host east of the Assistant bowed northward and sent off the goblet; the Assistant withdrew slightly; the host stood east of the western steps.
translations.idiomatic: The host east of the Assistant bowed north and sent off the goblet; the Assistant stepped back; the host stood east of the west steps.

sentences.zh: 贊者薦脯、醢于介席前，介進自北方，升席，贊者設折俎，介跪，左執爵，右祭脯、醢，遂祭酒，執爵興，自南方降席，北面跪，卒爵，執爵興，介授主人爵，主人適尊實之，酢於西階上，立於介右，北面跪，奠爵，遂拜，執爵興。

translations.literal: Announcers presented dried meat and relish before the Assistant's mat; the Assistant advanced from the north, ascended the mat; announcers set the divided offering; the Assistant knelt, held the goblet left, offered dried meat and relish right, offered wine, held the goblet and rose, descended south of the mat, knelt northward, finished the goblet, held the goblet and rose; the Assistant handed the host's goblet; the host went to the vessel and filled it, toasted on the western steps, stood east of the Assistant, knelt northward, set the goblet, then bowed and held the goblet and rose.
translations.idiomatic: Announcers set relish before the Assistant; he advanced from the north, ascended, offered meat and relish, libated, rose, descended south, knelt north, drained the goblet, handed it to the host; the host refilled and toasted on the west steps, stood east of the Assistant, knelt north, set the goblet, bowed, and rose.

sentences.zh: 介答拜。

translations.literal: The Assistant returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 主人跪祭，遂飲，卒爵，執爵興，進，跪奠爵于西楹南，還阼階上，揖降。

translations.literal: The host knelt, libated, then drank, finished the goblet, held the goblet and rose, advanced, knelt and set the goblet south of the western pillar, returned to the host steps, saluted, and descended.
translations.idiomatic: The host knelt, libated, drank, finished the goblet, advanced, knelt and set it south of the west pillar, returned to the host steps, saluted, and descended.

sentences.zh: 介降，立于賓南。

translations.literal: The Assistant descended and stood south of the Guest.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant descended and stood south of the Guest.

sentences.zh: 主人于阼階前西南揖眾賓，遂升，適西楹南，跪取爵，興，適尊實之，進於西階上，南面獻眾賓之長，升西階上，北面拜，受爵。

translations.literal: The host southwest of the host steps saluted the Mass Guests, then ascended, went south of the western pillar, knelt, took a goblet, rose, went to the vessel and filled it, advanced on the western steps, faced south, and presented to the chief Mass Guest; he ascended the western steps, bowed northward, and received the goblet.
translations.idiomatic: The host saluted Mass Guests southwest of the host steps, ascended, knelt south of the west pillar, filled a goblet, advanced on the west steps facing south to the chief Mass Guest, who ascended, bowed north, and received it.

sentences.zh: 主人于眾賓長之右，北面拜送。

translations.literal: The host east of the chief Mass Guest bowed northward and sent it off.
translations.idiomatic: The host east of the chief Mass Guest bowed north and sent it off.

sentences.zh: 贊者薦脯、醢于其席前，眾賓之長升席，跪，左執爵，右祭脯、醢，祭酒，執爵，興，退於西階上，立飲訖，授主人爵，降，復位。

translations.literal: Announcers presented dried meat and relish before his mat; the chief Mass Guest ascended the mat, knelt, held the goblet left, offered dried meat and relish right, offered wine, held the goblet and rose, withdrew to the western steps, stood and finished drinking, handed the host's goblet, descended, and returned to position.
translations.idiomatic: Announcers set relish; the chief Mass Guest ascended, knelt, offered meat and relish, libated, rose, withdrew to the west steps, stood and drank, handed the goblet to the host, descended, and returned to station.

sentences.zh: 主人又適尊實之，進於西階上，南面獻眾賓之次者，如獻眾賓之長。

translations.literal: The host again went to the vessel and filled it, advanced on the western steps, faced south, and presented to the next Mass Guest, as to the chief.
translations.idiomatic: The host refilled, advanced on the west steps facing south to the next Mass Guest, as for the chief.

sentences.zh: 又次一人升，飲，亦如之。

translations.literal: Again the next person ascended, drank, and it was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The next guest ascended and drank likewise.

sentences.zh: 主人適尊實酒，進於西階上，南面獻堂下眾賓。

translations.literal: The host went to the vessel and filled wine, advanced on the western steps, faced south, and presented to the Mass Guests below the hall.
translations.idiomatic: The host filled wine and presented on the west steps facing south to courtyard Mass Guests.

sentences.zh: 每一人升，受爵，跪祭，立飲，贊者遍薦脯、醢於其位。

translations.literal: Each person ascended, received the goblet, knelt and offered, stood and drank; announcers presented dried meat and relish at each position.
translations.idiomatic: Each ascended, received the goblet, knelt and libated, stood and drank; announcers set relish at each station.

sentences.zh: 主人受爵、尊於篚。

translations.literal: The host received the goblet and returned the vessel to the basket.
translations.idiomatic: The host took the goblet and returned the vessel to the basket.

sentences.zh: 主人與賓一揖一讓升，賓、介、眾賓序升，即席。

translations.literal: Host and Guest saluted and yielded once each in ascending; Guest, Assistant, and Mass Guests ascended in order and took their mats.
translations.idiomatic: Host and Guest exchanged one salute and one yielding in ascending; Guest, Assistant, and Mass Guests ascended in order and sat.

sentences.zh: 設工人席于堂廉西階之東，北面東上。

translations.literal: Musicians' mats were set east of the western steps at the hall eaves, facing north and ascending east.
translations.idiomatic: Musicians' mats were east of the west steps at the hall eaves, facing north with precedence east.

sentences.zh: 工四人，先二瑟，後二歌。

translations.literal: Four musicians—first two zithers, then two singers.
translations.idiomatic: Four musicians—two zithers first, then two singers.

sentences.zh: 工持瑟升自階，就位坐。

translations.literal: Musicians holding zithers ascended the steps, took position, and sat.
translations.idiomatic: Zither players ascended, took station, and sat.

sentences.zh: 工鼓《鹿鳴》，卒歌。

translations.literal: Musicians struck "Deer Cry" and finished the song.
translations.idiomatic: They played "Deer Cry" and finished the song.

sentences.zh: 笙入，立於堂下，北面，奏《南陔》。

translations.literal: Pipes entered and stood below the hall facing north, playing "South Hill."
translations.idiomatic: Pipe players entered below the hall facing north and played "South Hill."

sentences.zh: 乃間歌，歌《南有嘉魚》，笙《崇丘》；

translations.literal: Then alternating song—sang "South Has Fine Fish," pipes played "Lofty Mound;"
translations.idiomatic: Then alternate song—"South Has Fine Fish," pipes "Lofty Mound;"

sentences.zh: 乃合樂《周南》《關雎》、《召南》《鵲巢》。

translations.literal: then combined music: "Zhou South" "Fish Hawks," "Shao South" "Magpie Nest."
translations.idiomatic: then combined music: "Zhou South" "Fish Hawks" and "Shao South" "Magpie Nest."

sentences.zh: 司正升自西階司正謂主人贊禮者，禮樂之正。

translations.literal: The Director of Corrections ascended the western steps—the Director of Corrections is the host's ritual announcer, the rectifier of ritual and music.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Corrections ascended the west steps—the host's ritual announcer who keeps ritual and music in order.

sentences.zh: 既成，將留賓，為有懈墮，立司正以監之。

translations.literal: When complete, about to detain the Guest lest there be laxity, a Director of Corrections was installed to oversee it.
translations.idiomatic: When the preliminary rites ended, a Director of Corrections was appointed to watch lest guests grow lax before the feast continued.

sentences.zh: 跪取觶於篚，興，適尊實之，降自西階，詣階間，左還，北面跪，奠觶，拱手少立，跪，取觶，遂飲，卒觶，奠，再拜。

translations.literal: He knelt, took a cup from the basket, rose, went to the vessel and filled it, descended the western steps, went to the foot of the steps, turned left, knelt northward, set the cup, bowed with hands joined and stood briefly, knelt, took the cup, then drank, finished the cup, set it down, and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: He knelt, took a cup from the basket, filled it, descended the west steps to the foot, turned left, knelt north, set the cup, bowed briefly, drank it dry, set it down, and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 賓降席，跪取觶於篚，適尊實之，詣阼階上，北面酬主人。

translations.literal: The Guest left the mat, knelt, took a cup from the basket, went to the vessel and filled it, went to the host steps, faced north, and returned the toast to the host.
translations.idiomatic: The Guest left the mat, knelt, took a cup, filled it, went to the host steps facing north, and returned toast to the host.

sentences.zh: 主人降席，進，立於賓東，賓跪奠觶，遂拜，執觶興，主人答拜，賓立飲，卒觶，適尊實之，阼階上東南授主人，主人再拜，賓少退，主人受觶，賓于主人之西，北面拜送，賓揖，復席。

translations.literal: The host left the mat, advanced, and stood east of the Guest; the Guest knelt and set the cup, then bowed, held the cup and rose; the host returned the bow; the Guest stood and drank, finished the cup, went to the vessel and filled it, on the host steps southeast handed it to the host; the host bowed twice; the Guest withdrew slightly; the host received the cup; the Guest west of the host bowed northward and sent it off; the Guest saluted and returned to his mat.
translations.idiomatic: The host left the mat and stood east of the Guest; the Guest knelt, set the cup, bowed, and rose; the host returned the bow; the Guest stood, drank, refilled, handed it southeast on the host steps; the host bowed twice; the Guest stepped back; the host took the cup; the Guest west of the host bowed north and sent it off, saluted, and returned to his mat.

sentences.zh: 主人進西階上，北面酬介，介降席，自南方進，立于主人之西，北面。

translations.literal: The host advanced to the western steps, faced north, and returned toast to the Assistant; the Assistant left the mat, advanced from the south, and stood west of the host facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The host advanced to the west steps facing north to toast the Assistant; the Assistant left the mat, came from the south, and stood west of the host facing north.

sentences.zh: 主人跪奠觶，遂拜，執觶興，介答拜。

translations.literal: The host knelt and set the cup, then bowed, held the cup and rose; the Assistant returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The host knelt, set the cup, bowed, and rose; the Assistant returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 主人立飲，卒觶，適尊實之，進西階上，西面立，介拜，主人少退，介受觶，主人于介東，北面送，主人揖，復席。

translations.literal: The host stood and drank, finished the cup, went to the vessel and filled it, advanced on the western steps, stood facing west; the Assistant bowed; the host withdrew slightly; the Assistant received the cup; the host east of the Assistant sent it off facing north; the host saluted and returned to his mat.
translations.idiomatic: The host stood, drank, refilled, advanced on the west steps facing west; the Assistant bowed; the host stepped back; the Assistant took the cup; the host east of him sent it off facing north, saluted, and returned to his mat.

sentences.zh: 司正升自西階，近西，北面立，相旅曰：「某子受酬。

translations.literal: The Director of Corrections ascended the western steps, stood near the west facing north, and announced the round: "So-and-so receives the return toast.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Corrections ascended the west steps, stood near the west facing north, and called the round: "So-and-so receives return toast.

sentences.zh: 」受酬者降席，自西方進，北面立於介右。

translations.literal: " The recipient of the toast left the mat, advanced from the west, and stood north of the Assistant facing north.
translations.idiomatic: " The recipient left the mat, came from the west, and stood north of the Assistant facing north.

sentences.zh: 司正退，立於序端，東面，避受酬者。

translations.literal: The Director of Corrections withdrew and stood at the end of the sequence facing east, avoiding the recipient.
translations.idiomatic: The Director withdrew to the sequence end facing east, yielding to the recipient.

sentences.zh: 介跪奠觶，遂拜，執觶興，某子答拜。

translations.literal: The Assistant knelt and set the cup, then bowed, held the cup and rose; So-and-so returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant knelt, set the cup, bowed, and rose; the recipient returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 介立飲，卒觶，適尊實之，進西階上，西南面授某子，某子受觶，介立於某子之左，北面，揖，復席。

translations.literal: The Assistant stood and drank, finished the cup, went to the vessel and filled it, advanced on the western steps, faced southwest and handed it to So-and-so; So-and-so received the cup; the Assistant stood left of So-and-so, faced north, saluted, and returned to his mat.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant stood, drank, refilled, advanced on the west steps, faced southwest and passed it to the recipient; he took the cup; the Assistant stood left of him, faced north, saluted, and returned to his mat.

sentences.zh: 司正曰：「某子受酬。

translations.literal: The Director of Corrections said: "So-and-so receives the return toast.
translations.idiomatic: The Director called: "So-and-so receives return toast.

sentences.zh: 」受酬者降席，自西方立於某子之左，北面，某子跪奠觶，遂拜，執觶興，受酬者答拜。

translations.literal: " The recipient left the mat, stood west of So-and-so left of him facing north; So-and-so knelt and set the cup, then bowed, held the cup and rose; the recipient returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: " The recipient left the mat, stood west of So-and-so facing north; So-and-so knelt, set the cup, bowed, and rose; the recipient returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 某子立飲，卒觶，適尊實之，進西階上，西南面授之，受酬者受觶，某子立於酬者之右，揖，復席。

translations.literal: So-and-so stood and drank, finished the cup, went to the vessel and filled it, advanced on the western steps, faced southwest and handed it over; the recipient received the cup; So-and-so stood right of the recipient, saluted, and returned to his mat.
translations.idiomatic: So-and-so stood, drank, refilled, advanced on the west steps facing southwest and passed it on; the recipient took the cup; So-and-so stood right of him, saluted, and returned to his mat.

sentences.zh: 次一人及堂下眾賓受酬亦如之。

translations.literal: The next person and the Mass Guests below the hall received return toasts likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The next guest and courtyard Mass Guests received return toasts in the same way.

sentences.zh: 卒受酬者以觶跪奠於篚，興，復階下位。

translations.literal: When return toasts were finished, the recipient knelt and set the cup in the basket, rose, and returned to position below the steps.
translations.idiomatic: When return toasts ended, the recipient knelt, set the cup in the basket, rose, and returned below the steps.

sentences.zh: 司正適阼階上，東面請命于主人，主人曰：「請坐於賓。

translations.literal: The Director of Corrections went to the host steps, faced east, and requested orders from the host; the host said: "Request that my lord sit with the Guest.
translations.idiomatic: The Director went to the host steps facing east and asked the host's order; the host said: "Ask the Guest to sit with me.

sentences.zh: 」司正回，北面告於賓曰：「請賓坐。

translations.literal: " The Director turned, faced north, and told the Guest: "Please sit.
translations.idiomatic: " The Director turned north and told the Guest: "Please be seated.

sentences.zh: 」賓曰：「唯命。

translations.literal: " The Guest said: "I obey.
translations.idiomatic: " The Guest said: "As you command.

sentences.zh: 」賓、主各就席坐。

translations.literal: " Guest and host each took their mats and sat.
translations.idiomatic: " Guest and host each sat on their mats.

sentences.zh: 若賓、主公服者，則降脫履，主人先左，賓先右。

translations.literal: If Guest and host wore court dress, they descended and removed shoes—the host left first, the Guest right first.
translations.idiomatic: If they wore court dress, they descended and removed shoes—host left foot first, Guest right foot first.

sentences.zh: 司正降，復位。

translations.literal: The Director of Corrections descended and returned to position.
translations.idiomatic: The Director descended and returned to station.

sentences.zh: 乃羞肉胾、醢，賓、主燕飲，行無算爵，無算樂，主人之贊者皆興焉。

translations.literal: Then meat slices and relish were served; Guest and host feasted leisurely, with unnumbered rounds of wine and unnumbered music—the host's announcers all participated.
translations.idiomatic: Then meat and relish were served; Guest and host feasted at ease with unnumbered wine rounds and music—the host's announcers all joined.

sentences.zh: 已燕，賓、主俱興，賓以下降自西階，主人降自東階。

translations.literal: When the feast was done, Guest and host both rose; Guest and below descended by the western steps, the host by the eastern steps.
translations.idiomatic: When feasting ended, Guest and host rose; Guest and below left by the west steps, the host by the east steps.

sentences.zh: 賓以下出，立於門外之西，東面北上，主人送于門外之東，西面再拜，賓、介逡巡而退。

translations.literal: Guest and below exited and stood west outside the gate, facing east and ascending north; the host saw them off east outside the gate, faced west and bowed twice; Guest and Assistant withdrew with hesitation.
translations.idiomatic: Guest and below stood west outside the gate facing east; the host saw them off east of the gate, faced west and bowed twice; Guest and Assistant withdrew with hesitation.

sentences.zh: 季冬之月正齒位，則縣令為主人，鄉之老人年六十以上有德望者一人為賓，次一人為介，又其次為三賓，又其次為眾賓。

translations.literal: In the last month of winter when teeth were set in order, the district magistrate was host; one village elder over sixty of virtue and standing was Guest, the next Assistant, then again three Guests, then again Mass Guests.
translations.idiomatic: In late winter when age ranks were set, the district magistrate was host; one worthy village elder over sixty was Guest, the next Assistant, then three Guests, then Mass Guests.

sentences.zh: 年六十者三豆，七十者四豆、八十者五豆，九十者及主人皆六豆。

translations.literal: At sixty, three dishes; at seventy, four; at eighty, five; at ninety and for the host, six dishes each.
translations.idiomatic: Age sixty received three dishes; seventy four; eighty five; ninety and the host each received six.

sentences.zh: 賓、主燕飲，則司正北面請賓坐，賓、主各就席立。

translations.literal: When Guest and host feasted leisurely, the Director of Corrections faced north and requested the Guest to sit; Guest and host each stood at their mats.
translations.idiomatic: At the leisurely feast the Director faced north and asked the Guest to sit; Guest and host each stood at their mats.

sentences.zh: 司正適篚，跪取觶，興，實之，進，立於楹間，北面，乃揚觶而戒之以忠孝之本。

translations.literal: The Director of Corrections went to the basket, knelt, took a cup, rose, filled it, advanced, and stood between pillars facing north; then raised the cup and admonished them on the root of loyalty and filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: The Director went to the basket, knelt, took a cup, filled it, advanced between pillars facing north, raised the cup, and exhorted them on loyalty and filial piety as the foundation.

sentences.zh: 賓、主以下皆再拜。

translations.literal: Guest, host, and below all bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: Guest, host, and all below bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 司正跪奠觶，再拜，跪取觶飲，卒觶，興，賓、主以下皆坐。

translations.literal: The Director of Corrections knelt and set the cup, bowed twice, knelt and took the cup and drank, finished the cup, rose; Guest, host, and below all sat.
translations.idiomatic: The Director knelt, set the cup, bowed twice, drank it dry, rose; Guest, host, and all below sat.

sentences.zh: 司正適篚，跪奠觶，興，降復位，乃行無算爵。

translations.literal: The Director of Corrections went to the basket, knelt and set the cup, rose, descended and returned to position, then performed unnumbered rounds of wine.
translations.idiomatic: The Director returned the cup to the basket, descended to station, then served unnumbered wine rounds.

sentences.zh: 其大抵皆如鄉飲酒禮。

translations.literal: The general procedure all followed the village drinking rite.
translations.idiomatic: In general the procedure followed the village drinking rite.
